messages:
Kelsey (People Ops): Hey everyone — thanks for the great questions during the all-hands about office hubs, desk hoteling, and offsite reimbursements. I'm dropping clarifications + next steps here. Please reply if you need more detail or a policy exception. :wave:

Samir (Eng): Quick win question — when does the new desk booking system go live? I still see the old form.

Kelsey (People Ops): Good call — rollout is tomorrow at 09:00 PT. We'll switch to the new hoteling portal (link in pinned). Old form will be disabled Friday. If you have saved desk preferences, they migrate automatically. :white_check_mark:

Anya (Product): For core days — is the expectation 3 fixed days/week or flexible? Team leads asked for clarity.

Kelsey (People Ops): Expectation is 2 fixed core days for HQ teams, 3 for customer-facing/co-located pods. But teams can opt for a team-level pattern via the Team Hybrid Form. If you make a change, notify people-ops and we'll update scheduling templates.

Raj (Sales): Offsite travel — what's covered for regional customer offsites vs company-wide offsites? E.g., meals, hotels, local transport?

Jules (People Ops): Short answer: company-wide offsites use the OFFSITE policy (company pays lodging, per-diem, and event meals). Regional customer offsites use Travel policy (book through travel portal, meals on per-diem unless pre-approved). I'll paste the expense codes below so finance can route correctly.

Marta (Finance): Expense codes: `OFFSITE_LODGE`, `OFFSITE_MEALS`, `TRAVEL_FLIGHTS`, `TRAVEL_LOCAL`. Use `OFFSITE_MEALS` only for group meals covered by the company. Individual meal reimbursements go under `TRAVEL_MEALS`.

Samir (Eng): Thanks — what's the per-diem amounts? Need for budgeting.

Jules (People Ops): Per-diem (standard): domestic $75/day, international $120/day. Exceptions for high-cost cities available with pre-approval from People Ops + Finance.

Anya (Product): Family stuff — do we reimburse childcare for parents attending multi-day offsites?

Kelsey (People Ops): Yes — childcare reimbursement is available up to $200/day with receipts for approved company offsites. Please submit a short request via the People Ops form at least 14 days before travel. We'll review ASAP.

Raj (Sales): Flight booking window? I booked a last-minute flight and it was pricey — will that be covered?

Marta (Finance): Cheaper fares within the 14-day booking window are preferred. If you must book <7 days before travel, include justification in the expense note. Emergency exceptions are OK.

Samir (Eng): Visa letters — will People Ops provide invitation letters for international offsites?

Kelsey (People Ops): Absolutely. Submit the travel details page + passport name to the People Ops travel request form. We generate invitation/visa support letters within 3 business days.

Anya (Product): Office access — will contractors get badge access to the satellite hub for the day of the offsite?

Kelsey (People Ops): Contractors can get day passes if their manager requests it via the Contractor Access Form 48 hours in advance. Security will issue a temporary badge at reception.

Samir (Eng): Parking at HQ — is it first-come-first-serve or reserved passes?

Jules (People Ops): HQ parking is limited. For scheduled offsite-heavy weeks we'll provision temporary reserved passes; otherwise it's first-come-first-serve. If you need a guaranteed spot for accessibility reasons, submit the Accessibility Request form.

Raj (Sales): Reimbursement timeline — after expense submission how long to get paid?

Marta (Finance): Standard turnaround is 10 business days after receipt & manager approval. For offsite-related lump-sum advances request at least 7 business days before travel.

Samir (Eng): One last thing — what expense code to use for shared Airbnb for a team offsite?

Marta (Finance): Use `OFFSITE_LODGE` and attach the booking confirmation and attendee list. If split across invoices, annotate who stayed which nights.

Anya (Product): Thanks — this helps. Can People Ops post a short checklist for organizers?

Kelsey (People Ops): Will do. Action items: 1) We’ll publish an Offsite Organizer checklist in the People Ops docs by EOD tomorrow, 2) Hoteling portal goes live 09:00 PT tomorrow, 3) People Ops travel + visa forms linked in the pinned message. If you need a policy exception, reply here or DM me. :thumbsup:

travel-bot: Reminder — new hoteling portal maintenance window scheduled 08:45-09:00 PT tomorrow, 15m.

Samir (Eng): Awesome, thanks Kelsey and team.

Kelsey (People Ops): Thanks all — closing the thread but feel free to reopen with follow-ups.
